required_clauses.title: Capital Contributions and Funding
required_clauses.description: Defines initial and ongoing capital contributions by partners, including valuation, timing, and consequences of non-payment.

required_clauses.title: Profit Sharing and Distributions
required_clauses.description: Sets how profits and losses are allocated among partners and when distributions occur.

required_clauses.title: Governance and Decision Making
required_clauses.description: Describes how decisions are made, voting rights, authority of managers, and resolution of deadlocks.

required_clauses.title: Admission of New Partners
required_clauses.description: Sets criteria and procedures for adding new partners, including approvals and documentation requirements.

required_clauses.title: Dissolution and Exit
required_clauses.description: Defines dissolution triggers, wind-down process, and how remaining assets and obligations are handled.

optional_clauses.title: Non-Solicitation (Optional)
optional_clauses.description: May include restrictions on solicitation of partners’ personnel, subject to enforceability.
